plan_description: Phase E smoke test: the same two legitimate remediations plans/sample-plan.json hand-authors as literal edits, but with edits left empty so a real model (gpt-5.6-sol) has to generate them. Deliberately targets the safe synthetic fixture, not the real stretch-goal repo -- this is the first live-model run in the project and should be validated small before spending real tokens on anything bigger.

phases.description: Add a guard clause so Calculator.Divide throws ArgumentException on a zero divisor instead of silently returning Infinity. Do not change Add, Subtract, or any other method.

Add a Calculator.Multiply(double a, double b) method that returns a * b, and add a corresponding test named Multiply_ReturnsProduct to the existing test runner (tests/SampleApp.Tests/Program.cs) that asserts Multiply(4, 5) == 20, following the exact same RunTest(...) pattern already used by the other tests in that file. Do not remove or change any existing tests.
